{{Quote|Whatever race built these places has long since died out. At least, insofar as the Imperial survey has been able to determine. This one's been converted to house the mine offices and Imperial headquarters for Mimban.|Stormtrooper|<ref name="SotME" />}}
The '''Imperial headquarters''' on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] was the centre of government for the five [[mine towns]], plus the location of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. It was converted from ruins originally built by one of the native species of Mimban, though the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] did not believe the [[Mimbanite]]s or [[Coway]] were responsible, but rather an extinct species.

The structure was a gray stone ziggurat, and was made of gray stone inside and out. To dress up the spartan surroundings the offices of the [[Captain-Supervisor]] were lavishly decorated with fur, both real and artificial. The offices also contained a false wall hiding a [[Viewscreen/Legends|Viewscreen]]. In the rear of the facility were holding cells for minor offenders, while another part of the structure near an outside wall had been converted into a secure jail.

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] the headquarters housed the administration of Captain-Supervisor [[Grammel]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were briefly held prisoner in the facility's jail.
